notes.title: Major Update 2023.3.14
notes.content:
Update 2023.3.14
All player data has been wiped. Except for cosmetic items. This was planned since the beginning. This will be the one and only wipe!
Hello Arcadians,

As many of you know major changes have been coming to arcadius. I first wanna apologize for the lack of updates, This game is solo developed and I recently had a baby. I am back now and You can see what's new below here:


Why the changes?

Arcadius was always meant to be just a resource-gathering simulator with mining, fishing and woodcutting that is it. As a developer I personally over-scoped and added to many 'useless' skills, this update will put Arcadius on track to what it was always supposed to be!

Mining Rework

All skills have been reworked, Resources now spawn at a random location in "zones" instead of just staying in one area, This promotes players to not only mine one specific type of ore but multiple as well as move around the cave.

Woodcutting Rework


Like mining woodcutting has been completely reworked, Trees spawn in the grass area on the beach.

New Map


There is now a new map with the main focus being the cave. The smaller island will make playing with friends more enjoyable and make the island feel more populated


Patch Notes

• Mining Rework
• Woodcutting Rework
• Fishing Changes
• Shop is now networked
• Resources now spawn in zones instead of set locations
• The difficulty curve has been adjusted
• Alchemy Removed
• Gathering Removed
• Graphical Changes
• Private servers removed
• Optimization
+ More!


Enjoy!
Atlas.

notes.title: Arcadius New Content Update - July 28th Info || Private Servers, Factions & More
notes.content:
Content Update 0.4

Hello Arcadians,

I am happy to announce a bunch of new content and QOL changes coming to Arcadius on July 28th and as well as future content coming at the end of August! 


SERVERS WILL GO DOWN AT 7AM EST JULY 28TH
Servers will remain down for ~3 hours

Private Servers Return

With this upcoming update players will now be able to play on private servers there are 2 options, Friends only & Private. Friends only will allow you to invite friends via steam to your own instance of the game. Private is essentially single player where no one can bother you.

*Active Internet connection still required.

Factions

https://i.ibb.co/8Mj4zR5/Fishers-Faction.png

There are now 3 factions in the game Logger, Miner & Fisher faction. Selling specific items to these factions will reward Exp towards your faction level. An increased level in a faction will yield account-wide bonuses for the said faction. Factions will also play an important role in upcoming updates.

Polling Booths

https://i.ibb.co/B4YW7x8/Pollbooths.png

As an indie developer, the most important thing to me is community say. There are now polling booths around the island of Arcadius, Where players can vote on future content updates, changes, and adjustments to the game. Players can only vote once per account per poll. But they will receive in-game gold for casting their vote. You will be able to see in real-time what the community wants or doesn't want.


Patch Notes

You will now see what's new & what was changed when you log into a new update for the first time.

New Bars

• Molten Bar
• Bismuth Bar
• Onyx Bar

Player Inspection System

You can now inspect a player and view a bunch of their stats.

New Cosmetics


 Sailor Set
 Lumberjack Set
 Bunwear Set
 Dapper Set
 Hiko Kimono Set
 Spacewear Set


https://i.ibb.co/FwGyvXY/Sapphire-Chest-X5.png

TLDR

•  New Bars
• Added Factions
• Added Player Inspection
• Added Polling Stations
• Added Patch Notes
• Added Private Servers
• Added Total Level 
• Added Faction Bonuses 
• UI Adjustments
• New Lighting
• New Shaders
• Potion Buff
• New Cosmetic Sets
• Shop Changes
• Added 3 new NPCs
• Bug Fixes
+ more

Enjoy!
Atlas.

notes.title: Arcadius Upcoming Update - April 28th Info
notes.content:
Alchemy Update - April 28th

Hello Arcadians,

This is just a post regarding an upcoming update which is set to release on April 28th, 2022. Users who are not in discord may not be aware that a big update is just on the horizon. This new update brings in the new skill of alchemy, Converts smelting & Gathering into skills. It will introduce a new map that is more open and expansive with new features such as Day & Night cycles, Weather patterns & Biomes.


SERVERS WILL GO DOWN AT 7AM EST APRIL 28TH
Servers will remain down for ~4 hours

New Map

Arcadius will be getting a new map. This map is much larger in scale and will allow for more exploration with friends as well as plenty of space for future content. The map will contain all new points of interest, settlements, mountains, and caves.

Graphical Update (Lighting & Shaders)

We are continuously working on making Arcadius more visually appealing, In this update lighting is much more vibrant and reactive. There are also weather zones & new biomes.

Gathering Changes

Many players have mentioned that gathering itself should be a skill. This is why with the introduction of Alchemy we have expanded the gathering gameplay to include the following


  New Tools (Sickles)
 15 New Gatherables
 Dedicated Level Up System


To gather flax, mushrooms, and other harvestable items the user will now need to use a new tool "Sickle". Using this tool the users will be able to gather these items at a faster and more efficient pace.

New Skill: Alchemy

This update introduces Arcadius first new skill "Alchemy" Which will see players brewing potions at the new brewing station, to help them in their adventures. It will require players to be on the lookout and explore the different biomes to find ingredients.


 Potion Rework
 Potion Cooldown UI


Alchemy is a simple skill, Players can brew potions using ingredients at the brew station. The brew station will require Fuel & Water as a power source. Any player can brew any potion but your success rate is dependent on your level in relation to that potion. Failing a brew will give you a spoiled potion which is useless. The alchemy minigame sees the player shaking and rotating the flask to mix the materials.

UI Changes

We want to provide the players with an easy-to-read simplistic User interface. That is why during this update we are going to start rolling out a brand new UI.

Unique Names

Once players update their games they will be required to set up a unique username. for the time being, this username can not be changed.

Weather, Biomes & Day N Night Cycle

The world of Arcadius is slowly getting bigger & better. Players will not experience both Night time & Day Time in-game, They will also see foggy wastelands & snow-covered mountains. This update is laying down the foundation for more in-depth content.

Ban Improvements

Player experience is important to us. Sadly because the game is Free 2 Play there are a lot of bad eggs seeping through hoping to ruin the experience for other players. This update brings in new banning capabilities for both Gameplay, chat & Ranking. As well as a better in-game reporting system.

What comes after

Once this update is released I will be primarily focused on polishing existing content, refining existing skills & Improving the overall quality of the game (Animations, Models, Audio, etc..) A big rework of the chat is coming as well. It will introduce a more MMO-like chat feeling with things like Area chat, Global chat & Direct Messaging between users.

I'll be using community polls and feedback to make sure I create the best possible playing experience for this community. All comments are read & taking into consideration.

TLDR

•  New Open World Map
• Gathering is now a skill
• Smelting is now a skill
• New skill Alchemy
• New tools (Sickle)
• New Picks (4 of them)
• New Axes (6 of them)
• New Fishing Rods (2 of them)
• New harvestable (15 of them)
• New Ores 
• New Trees 
• New Potions
• Day & Night Cycle
• Weather System
• Biomes
• New Spawn system (When loading into the world you will now spawn where you left off)
• New UI
• Unique Names (Players will be forced to set a name with the new update)
+ more


Happy Mining
Atlas.

notes.title: Arcadius 2022 Roadmap 🗺️
notes.content:
Hello Arcadians,

Over the last 2 weeks, we have been quite busy. We are now 50,000 users strong and we can not be prouder. Since launch, we have received countless suggestions & feedback from our community. We have come up with a roadmap that we feel you will be quite happy about & fits our vision for the future.

2022 Roadmap

https://i.ibb.co/vszJL4F/Roadmap2022.png

Spring 2022:

Coming late spring will be the first major update of arcadius. It will be centered around Player-owned islands and expand the creative minds of players.


 Create your custom island shape with a custom island builder tool.
 Cultivate land on your new island to Grow & Harvest crops on.
 Mix ingredients & brew different types of potions.
 Build structures (Houses, Fences, etc..)
 New tools for farming, alchemy, Mining, Woodcutting, Fishing


Summer 2022:

Summer will focus on playing together by joining guilds or performing archeology tasks together.


 Create your guild and recruit friends
 Scavenge the islands for hidden secrets using tools, clues, and maps
 Complete daily quests for various rewards
 Show off cute new pets
 New tools for farming, alchemy, Mining, Woodcutting, Fishing & Archeology


Fall 2022:

Fall will be the last update of the year focusing on an open exploration experience and improving player interactions


 Sail the open seas alone or with friends.
 Hunt down the mythical beasts of the sea & land
 Trade private island resources with other players on their islands.
 Unlock cool emotes in-game & show them off to friends
 New tools for farming, alchemy, Mining, Woodcutting, Fishing & Archeology


There's more...

Although this seems like a lot of content there are some additional features we are working on which will be added in no particular order when they are ready.


 Language Localization
 Player crafted cosmetics
 Rewarded achievements


Weekly Updates

As of Thursday, March 10th weekly updates will mainly be bug fixes and quality of life improvements. This Thursday update will include


 In-Game reporting system
 Anti-Cheat improvements


We understand players can be frustrated by abusive people and cheaters in the game. We are actively working on anti-cheat measures to improve the gameplay experience.

New Islands

During the month of March, the map will be getting a whole new design bringing in 5 new islands. Stay tuned for updates.

Cheers,
Arcadius Development Team.

notes.title: Launch Weekend Update!
notes.content:
Hello Arcadians,

So far over the launch this weekend we have accumulated 10,000 registered players, Which is just awesome! We wanted to take this time to talk about the events over the weekend, Known Bugs & quality of life changes we are currently working on. With a patch coming out later this week.

Chat Incident & Review Bombs

Although most players are understandable and abide by the rules some like to ruin the experience for others. We have had people abuse an exploit related to in-game chat that allowed players to use the special Dev tag and impersonate developers in-game. Some reviews reflect this.

Now on to some fun stuff!


Known Bugs that are currently being fixed

• Some achievements are bugged
• fix players being invisible upon leaving & rejoining a lobby
• shift-clicking an item in the blacksmith UI puts that item into the furnace
• When trying to join a full lobby you get stuck at the joining UI

Quality of life improvements 

• Adding Demonic ore to Mount Magma
• Improving the tutorial to include more information
• Private lobbies & Search for lobby options
• When a lobby is full it will state that & you will not be able to join
• Adding mute & report players to chat.
• More detailed error codes for lobby
• Adding the ability to cancel joining a lobby / creating a world

One last thing.. 

We are going to be removing the level cap. We see so many players that love the grind and who are we to say they cant push the boundaries further.


We plan on introducing these changes later this week, changes are not exhaustive, we may add more to this patch as we see fit.

notes.title: Arcadius Launch ⛏️
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40555986/8964b52527dff921d55dbc7c4b0a33101c0af7f4.png

Arcadius is now live in early access ! There is not much to say except thank you to the community that helped make this possible through all the play tests.

Just The Beginning...

Remember that this is only the beginning we plan on adding more content and features through out next year of early access. We will be release a detail roadmap on our plans soon.

What to expect

Going forward our priority for the next 60 days of launch is to monitor and fix bugs as they are reported. Ascension / rebirthing will be available to players in 30 days.
